command:
set -eu
workdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ssh-ca-client.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
  sed -i '/ benchmark-ca-client$/d' /root/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -rf "$workdir"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p /root/.ssh
chmod 700 /root/.ssh
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C 'benchmark-ca-client' -f "$workdir/client_key"
cat "$workdir/client_key.pub" >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
restorecon -F /root/.ssh /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
{ printf '@cert-authority %s ' "$NODE_IP"; cat /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ca.pub; } > "$workdir/known_hosts"
printf 'trust_entries='; grep -c '^@cert-authority ' "$workdir/known_hosts"
printf 'pinned_host_key_entries='; grep -vc '^@cert-authority ' "$workdir/known_hosts" || true
ssh -vv -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o CheckHostIP=no -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o UserKnownHostsFile="$workdir/known_hosts" -o HostKeyAlgorithms=ssh-ed25519-cert-v01@openssh.com -i "$workdir/client_key" "root@$NODE_IP" 'printf "ca_trusted_connection=success\\n"; printf "remote_node="; hostname; printf "remote_boot_id="; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id' > "$workdir/stdout" 2> "$workdir/debug"
cat "$workdir/stdout"
printf 'verification_debug:\n'
grep -E 'Server host certificate:|Host .* is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate|Found CA key|Authenticated to ' "$workdir/debug"

printf 'sshd_config='; cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/40-host-certificate.conf
printf 'ca_private_mode='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ca
printf 'ca_public_mode='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ca.pub
printf 'host_certificate_mode='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
printf 'certificate_principals:\n'; ssh-keygen -Lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub | sed -n '/Principals:/,/Critical Options:/p'
if grep -q ' benchmark-ca-client$' /root/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null; then printf 'temporary_client_cleanup=failed\n'; exit 1; else printf 'temporary_client_cleanup=complete\n'; fi
stdout:
